'''Devon Izara''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek]] who was a [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]]. During the early [[Imperial Era]], she<ref name="Devon DB">{{Databank|devon-izara|Devon Izara}}</ref> crossed paths with the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] while she was on the run from the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ShadowLordTrailer" />

Izara had [[Color|pink]] skin and blue eyes, and she had a series of purple striped markings on her [[lekku]]. She used a blue [[lightsaber]].<ref name="ShadowLordTrailer" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Devon Izara will appear in the [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]'', set to premiere on [[April 6]], [[2026]]. She will be portrayed by [[Gideon Adlon]]. She was first identified on the [[StarWars.com]] article "''Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord'' Teaser Trailer and First Poster Arrive", published on [[January 22]], [[2026]].<ref name="ShadowLordTrailer" /> On [[March 26]], 2026, the article "Embrace your Inner Jedi with Devon Izara’s Legacy Lightsaber - Reveal" was released on [[StarWars.com]]. The article revealed Izara's blue lightsaber was the latest lightsaber of the "Limited Edition Legacy Lightsaber" series. The weapon has a silver and black [[hilt]], covered with a distinctive weathered brown faux [[leather]] grip. The hilt's switch activates lightsaber noises and illuminates the attachable lightsaber blade in a brilliant blue.<ref name="Legacy saber">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-legacy-lightsaber-devon-izara|text=Embrace your Inner Jedi with Devon Izara's Legacy Lightsaber - Reveal}}</ref>
